title: Tom Lehrer - Wernher von Braun
summary: Tom Lehrer's satirical song about Wernher von Braun, the German rocket scientist who went from the Nazi missile program to the US space program. It includes the famous line about not caring where the rockets come down.
why: HN quotes it constantly, mostly as a joke or reference, whenever rocketry, engineers' ethics or skill-versus-morality comes up.

quote.text: Tom Lehrer is indeed a national treasure, and his satire is top shelf.
